adopted.note: R, Teff, L from the SED+parallax fit; M, rho, age, logg from the MIST grid fed with (Teff, R, [M/H])

mist.prior: Kroupa IMF x uniform age x uniform [Fe/H] grid nodes; MIST v1.2 vvcrit0.4, 0.5-3 Msun

catalogue_consensus.note: StarHorse19 (Teff 7131, A_V 1.14) excluded: DR2-based, A_V above the total column

Gaia_MSC.note: binary-star model; distance 738 pc conflicts with the parallax (1300 pc)

nominal_pair_local.note: PSF pair LC (F_t+F_n), per-transit quadratic baselines profiled, D ~ N(5.32, 0.06)

mass_from_radius.note: valid only if the companion is a main-sequence M dwarf

eb_twin_2P.note: Same data and sigma_s as the transit fit; transit model has 7 shape parameters + D, twin model 7.

phase_curve.note: A_ell: amplitude of -cos(4 pi phi) (minima at phases 0 and 0.5); A_beam: sin(2 pi phi) (maximum at phase 0.25); A_refl: -cos(2 pi phi) (maximum at phase 0.5). Neighbour-scale values = pair value / recovery x (1 + D).

exofop.notes: no notes field in the ExoFOP JSON

novelty.mast_products: only HLSP QLP and GSFC-ELEANOR-LITE for S13; no SPOC 2-min / TESS-SPOC / DV products

web_search.result: no page mentions any identifier of the star (2026-10-12)

ephemeris.window_rule: target alt > 30 deg and Sun alt < -12 deg from T1 - 1 h to T4 + 1 h
